title: الفاتورة
headline: الليزر 1500 درهم للمرة · غوتيفا 5 دراهم فالنهار
problem: الخطوط الحمرين والبيضين اللي بقاو من الولادة باقين، واخا صرفتي على الكريمات والزيوت وحتى الليزر.

hook_card.text:
صرفتي على الكريمات والزيوت… والخطوط ديال الولادة باقين؟
حسبيها معانا

shots.vo_line: خطوط حمرين وبيضين من الولادة… وها شحال صرفتي عليهم!
shots.h3_prompt: The cream, oil and baby-oil land on the marble counter with a squashy bounce, the alum's rock chips settle and the cotton balls bounce to a stop. The cabinet's mirror face talks dramatically with clear, natural mouth movement on every word from the start until the very end, its open door swinging gently. The others wobble, blink and look up at it with closed mouths. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: الشبة وجونسون… زيت اللوز والأركان… شوية هنا وشوية هنا.
shots.h3_prompt: The plain paper roll keeps unrolling slowly toward the floor, its curled top end turning. The alum, the baby-oil and both oil bottles march along it one after another, the alum scowling, the baby-oil hurrying nervously, all with closed mouths. To the end they keep marching in step, bobbing, blinking and swinging their arms, while the paper keeps creeping forward. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.qa: re-roll a: The paper rolls back up and recedes into the room instead of unrolling forward. From ~2.2 s the marchers bunch up: the two oil bottles stack into a totem, one standing on the other's cap, and the baby-oil overlaps the alum (looks merged). Only 0.4-2.0 s is clean, against a 4.41 s VO.

shots.vo_line: أنا ب 250 درهم! وسالات فشهر، وكترطب غير الفوق.
shots.h3_prompt: The cream tube puffs out its chest, hands on hips, and boasts poshly with clear, natural mouth movement on every word (0-2.3 s); the Guttiva bottle listens with a closed mouth and slowly raises one eyebrow. Then the Guttiva bottle answers calmly with clear, natural mouth movement until the very end, gesturing with its little arm. The Guttiva bottle keeps its exact shape and label. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Guttiva label small print and Arabic line slightly garbled (main words Guttiva / SERUM / ANTI-VERGETURES / 60 ml clean)

shots.vo_line: أنا 1500 درهم للمرة… وخاصك بزاف ديال المرات. ومشية وجية للعيادة.
shots.h3_prompt: The laser machine rolls forward a little and stops. Its screen face talks coldly with clear, natural mouth movement on every word (0-4 s), the blue light on its front pulsing. Then it closes its mouth, blinks slowly and stares flatly, rocking slightly on its wheels, the blue light pulsing calmly until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.qa: re-roll b: Talking shot whose mouth moves only ~2.2-4.0 s. From 0.4 to 2.1 s the machine rolls well forward and turns with a closed smile, and from 4.1 s it stares with a closed frown (idle tail, idle_from 4.6). That is about 1.8 s of speech for a 5.51 s line. Its cute face also turns stern.

shots.vo_line: كاملين خدمو على الفوق. والخط؟ جرح لتحت.
shots.h3_prompt: The cut end of the paper strip lifts and curls gently in a breeze and settles back on the table. The red rubber stamp rocks once on its base and comes to rest. To the end the bougainvillea and olive leaves sway softly, the lantern flickers and sunlight shadows drift slowly across the wall. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: no characters in frame (payment terminal + paper strip with blank red stamp ring + rubber stamp) although the brief motion asks for character blinks/head tilts; animated as a still life
shots.qa: window: Used only for ~1.6 s before the R1 insert. The paper end lifts and twists in the breeze (1.1-1.7 s, its tip seen edge-on) and the stamp rocks: acceptable. From ~2.2 s strong leaf shadows sweep in and the wall brightens (lighting change), so end at 2.1 s.

shots.vo_line: وماشي غير انتي… هادشي اللي كتكتب الماماوات.

الخط جرح لتحت، فين الكولاجين اللي كيشد الجلد تقطع. الزيت والكريمة كيوقفو فالفوق، حيت الجلد فالفوق بحال حيط. أنا خفيف، كندوز لتحت: أركان كيغذي ويرجع المرونة، فيتامين E كيعاون الجلد يتجدد، الألوفيرا كتبرد الحمورية، والخزامى كتهدن. هكا الجلد كيصلح راسو من الجذر.
أنا جوج قراعي، 60 يوم، 299 درهم. يعني 5 دراهم فالنهار.
shots.h3_prompt: The Guttiva bottle tugs the short paper slip off the little pink printer with a snap and lifts it up proudly, letting the long paper strip flop onto the table. It talks cheerfully with clear, natural mouth movement on every word from the start until the very end, waving the short slip, nodding and giving a small happy hop. The Guttiva bottle keeps its exact shape and label. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

To the end it sways gently from side to side, breathing and blinking, smiling with its mouth closed. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. To the end the bougainvillea and olive leaves sway softly, the leaf shadows drift across the wall and the lantern flickers. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. shots.vo_line: جوج قراعي، شهرين كاملين، ب 299 درهم بلاصة 398. التوصيل فابور، وكتخلصي غير ملي يوصلك.
